normalized_mechanism: Before entering upon execution of the presidential office, the President must take the constitutionally prescribed oath or affirmation.
negative_condition: Execution of the presidential office under this source is not procedurally complete before the prescribed oath or affirmation is taken.

normalized_mechanism: The President serves as Commander in Chief of the Army and Navy and of State Militia when the Militia is called into actual service of the United States.
negative_condition: Commander-in-Chief authority over State Militia under this clause does not attach outside the stated federal-service condition.

normalized_mechanism: The President may require written opinions from principal executive-department officers on subjects relating to the duties of their respective offices.
negative_condition: The written-opinion authority established by this clause is bounded to principal executive officers and subjects related to their official duties.

normalized_mechanism: The President may grant reprieves and pardons for offenses against the United States except in cases of impeachment.
negative_condition: The pardon authority established by this clause does not extend to impeachment cases or offenses outside the stated United States domain.

normalized_mechanism: Treaty making requires presidential action with the advice and consent of the Senate and concurrence of two thirds of Senators present.
negative_condition: A treaty is not authorized through this source without the required Senate participation and two-thirds concurrence threshold.

normalized_mechanism: The President is granted the nomination function within the federal appointment process.
negative_condition: Nomination under this clause does not itself constitute completed appointment authority where the source separately requires Senate advice and consent.

normalized_mechanism: Appointment of the identified federal officers requires presidential appointment by and with the advice and consent of the Senate, except where the Constitution otherwise provides.
negative_condition: For covered offices, presidential nomination or unilateral presidential action alone does not complete the appointment authority established by this clause.

normalized_mechanism: Congress may by law vest appointment of inferior officers in the President alone, the Courts of Law, or Heads of Departments.
negative_condition: Inferior-officer appointment authority does not vest in one of the identified alternative principals under this clause absent congressional action by law.

normalized_mechanism: The President may fill vacancies occurring during the recess of the Senate by granting commissions.
negative_condition: The recess-appointment authority established here is conditioned on the vacancy and Senate-recess circumstances stated in the source.

normalized_mechanism: A commission granted through the recess-vacancy mechanism expires at the end of the Senate's next session.
negative_condition: The source does not authorize such a recess commission to continue beyond the stated expiration point.

normalized_mechanism: The President must from time to time provide Congress information on the State of the Union.
negative_condition: The constitutional information duty established by this source is not satisfied by eliminating the required communication to Congress.

normalized_mechanism: The President may recommend to Congress measures judged necessary and expedient.
negative_condition: The source establishes a recommendation function rather than unilateral legislative enactment authority.

normalized_mechanism: On extraordinary occasions, the President may convene both Houses or either House of Congress.
negative_condition: The convening authority established by this clause is conditioned on the source's extraordinary-occasion trigger.

normalized_mechanism: When the Houses disagree concerning the time of adjournment, the President may adjourn them to a time the President determines.
negative_condition: Presidential adjournment authority under this clause does not arise absent the stated inter-House disagreement concerning adjournment time.

normalized_mechanism: The President is assigned the function of receiving ambassadors and other public ministers.
negative_condition: The authority established by this clause is bounded to the identified diplomatic-reception function.

normalized_mechanism: The President must take care that the laws are faithfully executed.
negative_condition: The executive duty established by this source does not authorize abandonment of the faithful-execution requirement.

normalized_mechanism: The President must commission all officers of the United States.
negative_condition: The source-assigned commissioning function is not transferred to an unidentified principal by this clause.

normalized_mechanism: The President, Vice President, and civil officers of the United States are removed from office upon impeachment for and conviction of the stated constitutional offenses.
negative_condition: Removal through this mechanism is not constitutionally completed by impeachment without conviction or conviction absent the required impeachment process.

normalized_mechanism: The judicial power of the United States is vested in one Supreme Court.
negative_condition: Federal judicial authority is not established by this clause in an unidentified alternative supreme tribunal.

normalized_mechanism: Federal judicial power may also be vested in inferior courts that Congress ordains and establishes.
negative_condition: An inferior federal court does not acquire the judicial authority described here absent constitutionally permitted congressional establishment.

normalized_mechanism: Judges of the Supreme and inferior federal courts hold office during good behavior.
negative_condition: Judicial tenure established by this clause remains bounded by the good-behavior condition.

normalized_mechanism: Federal judges are entitled to receive compensation for their services at stated times.
negative_condition: The compensation entitlement established here is tied to covered judicial service.

normalized_mechanism: Compensation of federal judges may not be diminished during their continuance in office.
negative_condition: A reduction of covered judicial compensation during continuance in office is prohibited.

normalized_mechanism: Federal judicial power extends to cases in law and equity arising under the Constitution, federal laws, and treaties made under United States authority.
negative_condition: The federal judicial jurisdiction established by this clause is bounded to the identified federal-source case domain.

normalized_mechanism: Federal judicial power extends to cases affecting ambassadors, other public ministers, and consuls.
negative_condition: The jurisdiction established by this clause is bounded to cases affecting the identified diplomatic actors.

normalized_mechanism: Federal judicial power extends to cases of admiralty and maritime jurisdiction.
negative_condition: The jurisdiction established by this clause is bounded to the identified admiralty and maritime domain.

normalized_mechanism: Federal judicial power extends to controversies in which the United States is a party.
negative_condition: Party-based jurisdiction under this clause requires the United States to be a party to the controversy.

normalized_mechanism: Federal judicial power extends to controversies between two or more States.
negative_condition: The interstate jurisdiction established here requires the constitutionally identified State-party configuration.

normalized_mechanism: The source text extends federal judicial power to controversies between a State and citizens of another State.
negative_condition: The jurisdictional class stated in this original source remains bounded to the identified party configuration.

normalized_mechanism: Federal judicial power extends to controversies between citizens of different States.
negative_condition: The jurisdictional class established here requires the identified different-State citizenship configuration.

normalized_mechanism: Federal judicial power extends to controversies between citizens of the same State claiming lands under grants of different States.
negative_condition: Jurisdiction under this clause requires the stated same-State citizenship and conflicting-State-land-grant configuration.

normalized_mechanism: The source text extends federal judicial power to controversies between a State or its citizens and foreign States, citizens, or subjects.
negative_condition: The jurisdictional class stated in this original source remains bounded to the identified domestic-foreign party configuration.

normalized_mechanism: The Supreme Court has original jurisdiction in cases affecting ambassadors, other public ministers and consuls, and cases in which a State is a party.
negative_condition: Original Supreme Court jurisdiction under this clause does not attach outside the expressly identified case classes.

normalized_mechanism: In the other constitutionally identified cases, the Supreme Court has appellate jurisdiction as to law and fact, subject to exceptions and regulations Congress makes.
negative_condition: Appellate jurisdiction under this clause remains bounded by the identified residual case domain and constitutionally authorized congressional exceptions and regulations.

normalized_mechanism: Trials of crimes must be by jury except in cases of impeachment.
negative_condition: For covered criminal trials, the source procedure is not satisfied without a jury; impeachment is expressly excepted.

normalized_mechanism: A covered criminal trial must be held in the State where the crime was committed.
negative_condition: Trial venue under this clause is not constitutionally established in a different State when the crime was committed within a State.
